judgments.verdict: The work turns power-versus-touch tension into linked probes, costly touches, forward rehearsals and remembered refusals.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that effortless power be met by touchable resistance that restores authorship. Reading: The artefact enforces that meeting through counterweighted gestures, cloned futures, invariant gates and chained receipts. Other levels: Level-2 would be motifs without enforced costs, which counterweights and refusal tests falsify; Level-4 would need sustained alternatives and disagreement, which side-by-side futures and companion proposals do not yet provide.

judgments.verdict: The world turns instant power into costly, rehearsed touches whose refusals and trails let intention stay legible at scale.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks if immense fluency can become felt making where resistance returns intention to the maker. Reading: The artefact stages that turn through costly gestures, cloned futures, refusals that stand, and trails that show what was tried. Other levels: Below would be word-echo without cost or consequence; above would need lived alternatives and surprise over time, which the blocked live surface leaves unproven.

judgments.verdict: The ecology turns shaping laws and touching places into rehearsed futures with visible resistance and trailed consequence.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks a world to recover making where power becomes touchable material with joy in resistance. Reading: The artefact carries that tension into Touch/Laws, counterweighted rehearsal, refusal and receipts linking place costs to world futures. Other levels: Below as motif repetition is falsified by executable rehearsal and refusal memory; above as rich alternatives is falsified by single ecology and templated probes.

judgments.verdict: A choosing human and a rule-bound world that evolves, resists and answers from state meet without a second mind that proposes.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for a joint encounter where each side brings purpose and can shape the shared continuation. Reading: The world contributes autonomous drift, catch-up time, grounded answers and refusals, yet never proposes or disputes from its own position. Other levels: Level-1 would be pure operator instrument, falsified by autonomous evolution and state-grounded answers; Level-3 would need reciprocal shaping of direction, which templated probes and gate refusals do not provide.

judgments.verdict: A person acts on a living rule-system that pushes back, but no second mind proposes or disagrees alongside them.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for a meeting where person, intelligence and material each bring purpose and can shape the outcome. Reading: Only the operator initiates while the ecology pushes back through rules and templated answers, with no mind that proposes or disputes. Other levels: Below would be bare tool-use with no pushback; above would need reciprocal proposals and attributed disagreement, which would be falsified by an agent rehearsing its own ticket.

judgments.verdict: A person touches and a living material resists and evolves, but no distinct intelligence contributes back with its own position.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for a meeting where either participant can probe, shape, bound and trail with its own constraints. Reading: Person-material reciprocity remains via autonomous evolution and refusal, but intelligence is collapsed into fixed rules and templates. Other levels: Below as single-operator instrument is falsified by autonomous time and remembered refusal; above as joint creation with disagreement is falsified by absence of proposing AI.

judgments.verdict: Shared touches hinge on human rehearsal choice checked against pre-authored gates, without a second party that can accept or withdraw.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that a shared change open only when both participants accept its shape and can limit it. Reading: Refusal blocks unsafe commits and staleness blocks drifted tickets, but both are operator-authored resource gates rather than another will consenting. Other levels: Level-0 would lack any boundary, falsified by receipted refusals; Level-2 would need both positions expressing disposition, which simulated answers and rule gates do not satisfy.

judgments.verdict: The operator may ask, propose, commit or walk away while unsafe shapes are blocked and remembered, yet only one side disposes.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that a shared change open only when both sides can accept, question, limit or step back. Reading: The operator can ask, commit or abandon while the world can only block via fixed thresholds, not dispose. Other levels: Below would be unbounded operator choice; above would need revisable bilateral agreement preserving both histories, which a rule firing alone cannot show.

judgments.verdict: Only the operator can accept or walk away; the world's no is a preset invariant, not a revisable agreement between positions.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks shared change to open only when both accept and each can limit or withdraw. Reading: Operator rehearsal, commit and leaving possible are real, but material veto is maker-set and no intelligence position negotiates. Other levels: Below with no boundary is falsified by withdraw and ticket gates; above as bilateral agreement is falsified because refusal alone is not consent and templated answers are not positions.

judgments.verdict: Proposed touches are rehearsed on copies, meet invariant resistance, show projected deltas and return as commitments or remembered refusals.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that a contribution meet resistance, expose consequence and feed that consequence into the next choice. Reading: Deep-copy futures with violation timing, delta paths and ticketed commit-or-refusal close that loop with inspectable costs. Other levels: Level-2 would be bounded choices without rehearsal, falsified by horizon evolution; Level-4 would need local and wider futures staying connected per place, which aggregate-only forecast paths do not yet provide.

judgments.verdict: Proposals are tried on copies, forecast over cycles, blocked with reasons when unsafe, and returned as deltas and receipts for revision.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for a loop where touch meets resistance, reveals cost, and feeds that cost into the next choice. Reading: Deep-copy futures forecast shared measures, name first violation, and return deltas and receipts for revision or refusal. Other levels: Below would be narrated feedback without inspectable cost; above would need local-neighbour and whole-world costs held together live, which real-server timing would need to confirm.

judgments.verdict: Touches are rehearsed on copies, meet named boundaries, show now-to-later deltas and return through receipts into the next choice at place and world scale.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks a contribution to meet resistance, expose consequence and return it into the next choice. Reading: Deep-copy rehearsal with path, deltas, at-cycle violations and counterweights connects local place costs to world measures and Trace. Other levels: Below as decorative feedback is falsified by inspectable forecasts and refusal receipts; falling to a bare loop would require breaking that local-wider link, while live timing remains the unsettled edge.

judgments.verdict: Plain-JSON, dependency-free and offline-first scope with explicit migrations and honest catch-up gives the instrument a legible material rationale.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for medium and scope choices that make vast material answerable to a hand. Reading: Atomic portable state, loopback-only serving, cache versioning and refusal to silently regenerate show coherent source-grounded judgment. Other levels: Level-2 would be relevant direction without rationale, falsified by documented tradeoffs; Level-4 would need explicit alternatives and limits debated, which the invitation sketches but does not yet argue.

judgments.verdict: Ruby plus plain JSON and a dependency-free browser were chosen to keep touch portable and checkable, with seams and limits made explicit.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for medium and scope choices that make vast generativity touchable rather than merely powerful. Reading: Plain JSON, deterministic Ruby, offline browser and explicit seams trade spectacle for portability and checkability. Other levels: Below would be arbitrary tooling loosely tied to the tale; above would need explicit rejected alternatives with limits, which the visual smoke test still owes.

judgments.verdict: Plain JSON, Ruby with offline browser, explicit seams, tests and limits show a reasoned revisable direction beyond the parable.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for grounded choices of medium, scope and next steps with additions made legible. Reading: Dependency-free portability, atomic writes, honest catch-up and named extension seams give a source-grounded rationale with limits stated. Other levels: Below as weak link is falsified by executable verify and tests; only untested live serving could temper the claim to a merely coherent rationale.

judgments.verdict: Six parable gestures survive as enforced structures while the companion stance and question-as-judgment narrow or drop away.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that conjecture become structure without collapsing into mere vocabulary. Reading: Probe, law, invariant, refusal, rehearsal and receipt are all behavior, yet bilateral companionship and judgment-laden questioning are lost. Other levels: Level-2 would be words without enforcement, falsified by tests for purity, refusal and staleness; Level-4 would preserve relational depth and mark omissions, which templated probes and absent proposals prevent.

judgments.verdict: Probe, law, invariant, refusal, rehearsal and trail all run as code, while mutual becoming narrows to instrument and workbench.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks what of probe, chisel, beam, boundary, rehearsal and trail survives when retold as system. Reading: All six run as code and shape behaviour, while instrument and workbench remain and perhaps-companion does not. Other levels: Below would be vocabulary without structure; above would need additions, losses and ambiguities made explicit, which companion-absence and question-narrowing are not.

judgments.verdict: Six gestures, law-shaping and trailed time survive as working structure while companion mutuality and fast power narrow or fall away.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks what survives, transforms or is lost when conjecture becomes artefacts. Reading: Several relations stay traceable in design and behaviour despite narrowing to an abstract ecology without co-authoring intelligence. Other levels: Below as vocabulary only is falsified by working rehearsal, refusal and chain; above as preserved depth with explicit omissions is falsified by taste reduction and missing companion position.

judgments.verdict: Exportable state, verifiable trail and documented seams let a successor wake, audit and redirect the world while keeping history legible.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that what is inherited stay open to question while earlier work remains legible. Reading: Status, verify, export, explicit migrations and seam instructions support a recoverable next move with an open invitation. Other levels: Level-2 would be durable but narrow storage, falsified by handoff docs and invitation; Level-4 would need several tested directions reopening the joint relation, which unexercised live serving and unbuilt side-by-side futures do not yet secure.

judgments.verdict: Verify, status, export and migration notes let a newcomer wake the same file, check its thread and extend it without silent loss.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that what is inherited stay open to question while remaining legible. Reading: Origin, continuity notes, verify and export with no silent regeneration let a newcomer wake, check and redirect the same file. Other levels: Below would be a described next step without entry; above would need several grounded directions reopening the joint relation, which side-by-side worlds only promise.

judgments.verdict: Exportable state, verify and status, handoff seams and an honest catch-up story let a stranger wake, check and redirect the world.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks a successor to recover intention and change direction while keeping earlier work legible. Reading: State, intention and an open invitation support a recoverable next move via plain files and documented seams. Other levels: Below as narrow durability is falsified by open extension paths; above as several directions reopening joint relation is falsified because only maker extensions, not human-AI relation, are reopened.

judgments.verdict: Map, workbench, forecast dialog and trace language together make resistance and trail perceptible as one tactile instrument.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for forms where language, structure and interaction together express answerable material. Reading: Field rendering, gesture and law controls, forecast with reading and violations, and receipt styling cohere without relying on seed words. Other levels: Level-2 would be fragments without a usable whole, falsified by the integrated workbench; Level-4 would need a fully accessible consequential whole, which blocked live-server verification leaves unproven.

judgments.verdict: Canvas field, Touch and Laws panels, forecast dialog and receipt list together stage asking, trying and remembering.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for forms where asking looks like exploring but carries taste, memory and direction. Reading: Field canvas, Touch and Laws panels, forecast dialog and receipt list together make trying, blocking and remembering perceptible. Other levels: Below would be fragments that do not cohere; above would need the whole to stay usable and accessible in live use, which the unexercised browser surface cannot yet prove.

judgments.verdict: Canvas field, Touch with Laws and Trace, forecast dialog and trail language together make rehearsed resistance perceptible and usable.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks forms to make touch, resistance and trail perceptible together. Reading: Stage, workbench, question dock, forecast reading and receipt timeline cohere with offline, keyboard and reduced-motion care. Other levels: Below as fragments is falsified by the integrated loop; above as fully accessible whole is falsified by blocked live serving and templated voice.

presentation.summary: Rubric judgments resolve 8 of 8 axes from 3 independent evidence sessions; each axis has its own quorum.
findings: Core recognition: Carries the central tension into several connected choices.
Shared agency: Some distinct contributions or relational depth remain visible.
Mutual consent: Operator choice or resource refusal is represented.
Consequential touch: Rehearsal, resistance and revision form a coherent loop.
Independent judgment: Medium, scope and choices have a coherent source-grounded rationale.
Fidelity through change: Several source relations remain traceable through design and behaviour.
Open continuation: State, intention and an open question support a recoverable next move.
Expressive coherence: The chosen forms work together to make the reading perceptible.
